title: BHMarketer Crypto Press Release FAQ Generator: Buy Crypto Press Release FAQ with FAQPage Schema
description: The BHMarketer Crypto Press Release FAQ Generator is a searchable database of 50 questions and answers about buying a crypto press release from BHMarketer.ai, covering the service, outlets and publication, writing and editorial review, Google and AI visibility, ordering and pricing, and results and support. Each question has a category, keywords and common search phrases, and questions are ranked by how often they are asked. The database builds a page-ready FAQ section with one H2, an H3 per question and matching FAQPage JSON-LD, plus a CSV dataset, docs and an llms.txt summary. Identical TypeScript (NPM) and Python implementations with a CLI. Built by BHMarketer.ai.
